column1: dr_u1_sb1|一般过去时|But during dinner, I didn't feel ____ eating because I felt sick.|like|feel like doing 想要做某事；前面 didn't 提示用动词原形
dr_u1_sb2|固定搭配与动词短语|Sometimes I felt ____ I was walking inside a palace.|like|feel like ... 感觉像……（like 后可接句子）
dr_u1_sb3|固定搭配与动词短语|In the afternoon, we arrived ____ a school and met a group of Russian students.|at|arrive at + 小地点（学校、车站）；arrive in + 大地方（城市、国家）
dr_u1_sb4|复合不定代词|Later, someone took out his accordion, and soon everyone got ____ to sing and dance.|together|get together 聚在一起（固定短语）
dr_u1_sb5|从句（宾语/定语/状语）|We were ____ happy that we didn't notice the time.|so|so + 形容词 + that 从句：如此……以至于……
dr_u1_sb6|基础句型与其它|It was ____ a good experience!|such|such a + 单数名词；注意与 so + 形容词区分
dr_u1_sb7|一般过去时|It rained last night, so this morning the air was ____ and cool.|fresh|fresh and cool 清新又凉爽（教材原搭配）；rain 的过去式 rained
dr_u1_sb8|固定搭配与动词短语|We took the Moscow ____ to travel around.|Metro|Moscow Metro 莫斯科地铁；take + 交通工具 乘坐……
dr_u1_sb9|固定搭配与动词短语|I liked the ice cream there, so I ate a lot ____ it.|of|a lot of 许多（既可接可数也可接不可数名词）
